title: Good Deeds Day at Kalol Schools: Joy, Learning, and Kindness
excerpt: Megh Foundation volunteers spent a full day with students in Kalol schools through activities, talent sharing, and confidence-building engagement.
coverImageAlt: Megh Foundation volunteers and students during Good Deeds Day at Kalol schools
bodyMarkdown:
## A day built on connection

On Good Deeds Day, Megh Foundation volunteers visited Kumar Shala No. 10 and Kanya Shala in Kalol to spend meaningful time with students through play, learning, and mentorship.

## What happened during the visit

- Group activities and games that encouraged teamwork
- Talent-sharing sessions where students presented songs, poems, and skills
- Mentor conversations to inspire confidence and aspiration
- Distribution of thoughtful gifts aligned with student needs

## Why this initiative matters

The day reinforced an important message: when children are seen, encouraged, and supported, confidence grows quickly.

## Megh Foundation's commitment

Good Deeds Day reflects the foundation's long-term promise to keep showing up for youth with empathy, consistency, and action.
